correctness.rationale: All couplings J>0, delta=D/J real and x=|h|/J>=0 are covered. The labelled graph has 12 vertices, 30 edges; every one of the 3^12=531441 spin assignments was independently enumerated into (K,|M|,B), giving all 49 nonnegative-magnetization sector bond minima and degeneracies. Spin reversal gives h<0. All thirty omitted sectors have explicit nonnegative rational convex combinations of the 19 listed sectors matching K and at least M while not exceeding bond minimum; hence for x>=0 every omitted affine energy is dominated at arbitrary delta. All 19 selected rows have strict rational exposure witnesses with exact positive gaps against every one of the 49 sectors; thus precisely 19 open field chambers exist. At x=0 the envelope simplifies to min{-10+12delta,-8+8delta,0}; explicit boundary sums including occupancy-only ties are 462 at delta=1/2 and 351 at delta=1. Independent complete enumeration and certificate validation reproduced all claimed integers. Finite graph exhaustive proof is exact but not a thermodynamic-limit statement.
residual_risks: Finite independent computations corroborate but do not prove the arbitrary-parameter theorem unless the stated finite universe was exhaustively enumerated.
